evidence.title: Clear signals, clear limits.
evidence.description: The RFxchange distinguishes confirmed information, participant-provided information, and features that are not yet available.
rules: Illustrative images are identified as such.
Tutorial examples are kept separate from Exchange records.
Features that are not yet available are labeled as planned or in development.
Public opportunity information does not provide private access.
Verification and outcomes appear only when the required information exists.

help.title: How can we help?
help.intro: Find answers about joining RFxchange and using the Exchange.
help.question: Your question
help.empty: I don’t have an answer to that in the help guide. Try a question about joining, access, capabilities or membership.

join.title: How do I join?
join.answer: Start with Join Free. Create your account, find your organization, and follow the setup steps. If your organization is already listed, select it so you can establish access without creating a duplicate.

organization.title: My organization is already listed
organization.answer: Search for your organization during setup. Selecting a listing starts the access process; it does not automatically verify your organization. If someone already manages it, request access or ask them for an invitation.

capabilities.title: What are capabilities?
capabilities.answer: Capabilities describe what your organization can provide. Choose the entries that fit your business and confirm any suggestions before they become part of your profile.

opportunities.title: How do I find opportunities?
opportunities.answer: After setup, use the RFx lens to explore available opportunities. Search and filter results, inspect the details, and use the actions available for that opportunity.

pricing.title: Where can I review membership options?
pricing.answer: Review the membership page for the current offer and availability. Membership does not establish organization verification or guarantee a business outcome.
pricing.keywords: price pricing cost membership billing subscription

privacy.title: Who can see my information?
privacy.answer: Public information and private account information are handled separately. Review the privacy policy for details. This help assistant cannot look up accounts, private organization records, or billing information.

signin.title: I need help signing in
signin.answer: Use Sign in to access your account. Use the password recovery option there if needed. This assistant cannot change your password or grant access to an organization.
